title: Builder Signals · 2026-06-27
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 30 条 X 动态、1 集播客、1 篇博客；本站精选 10 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI's Codex lead Thibault shared adoption data this week with one key point: since the Codex App launched on Feb 2, uptake outside of engineering has visibly accelerated — meaning the coding agent is increasingly used as a general-purpose tool by non-engineers. His tagline "Codex for everything at OpenAI" signals it's become a cross-functional default assistant internally, not just a developer tool. The takeaway for enterprise adoption is direct: the real leverage of coding agents isn't replacing engineers, but…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Thibault 这周晒了一组关于 Codex 渗透率的数据，核心一句话：自 2 月 2 日 Codex App 发布以来，它在工程师群体之外的采用曲线明显抬头——也就是说，写代码的 agent 正在被非工程岗的人当成通用工具用。他配的口号是「Codex for everything at OpenAI」，意思是内部已经把 Codex 推成了跨职能的默认助手，而不只是程序员的工具。对企业落地的启示很直接：编程 agent 的真正杠杆不在替代工程师，而在让运营、产品、IR 这类岗位自助完成原本要排期给工程的小任务。

featured.title: Peter Yang · 实用 AI 教程创作者
featured.summaryEn: Peter Yang shared a concrete agent use case this week: planning another Japan trip in December, he had Codex use the browser to navigate Google Flights and individual hotel websites, scrape and save all prices for his target dates, return direct booking links, and compile everything into a doc — next he plans to just tell it to book the whole thing. It's a clear signal of agentic browsing moving from demo to daily use: not asking the model to "plan my trip," but having it actually visit multiple sites to compare a…
featured.insightZh: Peter Yang 这周给了一个很具体的 agent 用例：他计划 12 月再去日本，这次直接让 Codex 用浏览器去 Google Flights 和各家酒店官网，把指定日期的所有价格抓回来、存好、给出直接预订链接，并整理进一个文档——下一步他打算干脆让它「直接订完」。这是 agentic browsing 从演示走向日常的典型信号：不是问模型「帮我规划行程」，而是让它实际去多个网站执行比价和取数。他还吐槽现在手机上只能靠自制 iPhone 快捷指令直连 Codex，侧面反映 agent 的移动端入口还很不成熟。

featured.title: Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince 谈机器人接管、边缘 AI 与每个 CEO 都要面对的艰难决定
featured.summaryEn: For the first time in internet history, bot/AI-agent traffic surpassed human traffic in H1 2026; within five years bot traffic could be 1000x today's, and the old "ads fund the internet" model will break — because bots don't click ads. Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince drops a landmark stat: the prediction that automated traffic would overtake human traffic by end of 2027 actually happened in H1 2026. The driver is almost entirely AI agents — ask ChatGPT or Claude to buy a camera and it might visit 5,000 sites where you'd visit 5. That implies internet traffic could grow 1000x in five years, dwarfing the COVID-era doubling in demand for servers, network, CPUs/GPUs. More critically, it's a business-model inflection: the internet's 28-year model has been advertising, but bots don't click ads. Prince says the model will "radically change" over five years, and what it becomes is totally undefin…
featured.insightZh: 互联网史上首次，机器人/AI agent 流量在 2026 上半年超过了人类流量；五年内 bot 流量可能是今天的 1000 倍，而「广告养互联网」的旧商业模式将彻底失效——因为机器人不点广告。 Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince 在这期里抛出一个标志性数据：原本预测「自动化流量超过人类」要到 2027 年底，结果实际上在 2026 上半年就发生了。驱动力几乎全是 AI agent——你让 ChatGPT 或 Claude 帮你买个相机，它可能替你访问 5000 个网站，而你自己只会看 5 个。这意味着未来五年互联网流量可能涨 1000 倍，对服务器、网络、CPU/GPU 的需求是 COVID 期间流量翻倍的「量级碾压」。 更关键的是商业模式拐点：互联网 28 年的底层模式一直是广告，但 bot 不点广告。Prince 直言未来五年互联网商业模式会「彻底重构」，而它会变成什么，目前完全未定义。Cloudflare 自己则顺势从 CDN/安全公司转型成 AI 基础设施公司——Workers（基于浏览器 tab「isolate」概念的极轻量沙箱，天然适配 agentic 负载）、AI Gateway（审计 prompt、注入护栏、按任务智能路由模型省成本）都是「先为自己造、再变成产品」的 AWS 式路径。他算了笔账：如果每个知识工作者只配一个 agent，用传统 AWS 容器方式跑，CPU 消耗就是当前全球年产能的 40 倍——而现实是每人会有几百个 agent。 最有分量的是「艰难决定」这段：Cloudflare 裁掉了超过 20% 的团队，但 Prince 强调不是业务不行、也不是人不好，而是「不再需要那么多中层管理者和『度量者』(measurers)」——AI 在度量类工作上比人更强。他的核心论点很反直觉也很冷峻：一旦你确定这个变化必然发生，对团队最仁慈的做法就是尽快动手，因为今天找工作比 6-12 个月后容易得多，等大家同时裁人、市场被求职者淹没才是真正的「血洗」。他预测未来 6-12 个月几乎每家公司都会经历类似调整，很多 CEO 在拖，…

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
items.summaryEn: Thariq from Anthropic's Claude Code team dropped an interesting detail: the video he posted was itself edited by Claude — meaning the coding agent is already crossing over into non-code tasks like video editing. He also teased deeper discussions about "Claude Tag" (a new Claude Code capability) with Peter Yang and at the AI Engineer conference. For anyone tracking how far coding agents are expanding, the casual "the agent edited my video" says more about capability spillover than any roadmap.
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 抛了个有意思的细节：他发的那条视频本身就是 Claude 剪的——也就是说编程 agent 已经在跨界做视频剪辑这类非代码任务了。他还预告会和 Peter Yang、以及在 AI Engineer 大会上更深入聊「Claude Tag」（Claude Code 的一项新能力）。对关注 coding agent 边界扩张的人来说，「agent 顺手把视频剪了」这个小动作比任何 roadmap 都更能说明能力溢出的方向。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch posted several items this week about baking design standards into coding agents. One: Next.js error pages now carry "Copy prompt" buttons that turn errors directly into agent-ready prompts — he calls it "agentic art." Another covers how Vercel injects its team's design standards into coding agents so generated code automatically conforms to internal norms. Plus a hard data point: Grok Imagine Video has become the clear leader on Vercel's AI Gateway, at ~50% of developer-generated videos.…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 这周连发了几条关于「让设计标准内化进 coding agent」的内容。一条是 Next.js 报错页面现在带「Copy prompt」按钮，把报错直接变成可以喂给 agent 的提示词——他称之为「agentic 艺术品」。另一条讲 Vercel 如何把团队的设计规范注入到编程 agent 里，让生成的代码自动符合内部标准。还有个硬数据：Grok Imagine Video 已成为 Vercel AI Gateway 上最大的视频生成模型，约占开发者生成视频的 50%。三条合起来是一个信号：工具链正在系统性地把「人类的规范和品味」编码进 agent 的默认行为。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie posted two long reflections this week on AI regulation worth a read at the enterprise-strategy level. Core thesis: the US now has de facto AI regulation — models above certain capability or training-compute thresholds will likely need government review before release. He frames it as a "prisoner's dilemma at insane scale": if the US stays at the frontier while heavily regulating releases, it controls who gets frontier intelligence and when, yielding economic and geopolitical edge — but only if…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 这周写了两段对「AI 监管」的长思考，值得企业战略层一读。核心论点：美国现在已经有了事实上的 AI 监管——达到一定能力或训练算力的模型，大概率要先经政府审查才能发布。他把这套逻辑推演成一个「无限规模的囚徒困境」：如果美国一边保持前沿、一边对模型发布重度管制，就能控制谁、何时拿到前沿智能，从而获得经济和地缘优势；但前提是美国必须永远领先。一旦中国不放缓且模型追上来，美国的发布延迟反而会反过来给对手让路。他的结论：开放权重模型是这套格局里的明显赢家，因为主权 AI 大概率建立在开源之上，且暂时还能不受同等管制地进入市场。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder、Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang, author of the Follow Builders project, punctured a common misconception this week: many think "building an audience" is antithetical to "building a company," but she argues the two are increasingly the same thing. Storytelling — to users, investors, candidates — is arguably the founder's most important job. Her underlying read: building is getting cheaper while attention is getting more expensive. Put differently, when anyone can cheaply ship a product with AI, being able to articulate and be heard bec…
items.insightZh: Follow Builders 项目作者 Zara Zhang 这周戳破了一个常见误区：很多人觉得「建立受众」和「建公司」是对立的，但她认为这两件事正越来越变成同一件事。讲故事——对用户、对投资人、对候选人——可以说是创始人最重要的工作。她的底层判断是：构建（building）正在变便宜，而注意力（attention）正在变贵。换句话说，当人人都能用 AI 低成本造出产品时，能不能讲清楚、能不能被听见，反而成了真正的稀缺资源和竞争壁垒。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper helped a stealth NYC health-tech company recruit this week, and the job post itself reveals an emerging role: they're hiring a "Codex-native Chief of Staff / BizOps lead." The founder is ex-One Medical, ex-Bridgewater, a16z-backed, building "AI-first medicine with physical clinics." What's notable isn't the company but the job description — "Codex-native ops lead" signals that coding-agent fluency is spilling from engineering into operations/strategy roles as a hard requirement.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 这周帮一家隐身 NYC 健康科技公司招人，招聘信息本身透露了一个新趋势岗位：他们在招「Codex-native 的 Chief of Staff / BizOps 负责人」。创始人是前 One Medical、前 Bridgewater 背景、a16z 投资，做的是「AI-first 医疗 + 实体诊所」。值得注意的不是这家公司，而是「Codex-native 的运营负责人」这个职位描述——它意味着编程 agent 的熟练度正在从工程岗外溢成运营/战略岗的硬门槛。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: Ex-Dropbox CTO and now South Park Commons partner Aditya Agarwal made a sharp call this week: it's stupidly hard to start a pure software company right now. The reason: customers don't want software, they want outcomes, so you end up doing a lot of custom work for each one. Anything horizontal is on a ticking clock because every customer wants deep customization. He doesn't deny opportunities exist, but stresses you need a "very heretical" 2-3 year view of the world to build something good. For B2B founders, it's…
items.insightZh: 前 Dropbox CTO、现 South Park Commons 合伙人 Aditya Agarwal 这周下了个挺扎心的判断：现在做一家「纯软件公司」难得离谱。原因是客户不要软件，要的是结果（outcomes），所以你最后不得不为每个客户做大量定制。任何横向（horizontal）的产品都在「倒计时」，因为每个客户都想深度定制。他没有否定机会的存在，但强调你必须对未来 2-3 年有一个「相当异端」的判断，才能造出真正好的东西。对 to B 创业者，这是一句冷水也是一句方向：标准化 SaaS 的护城河在 AI 时代正在被定制化需求侵蚀。

items.title: 用 Foundation Models 框架在 Apple 平台上构建智能应用（Claude 接入）
items.summaryEn: Anthropic released Claude support for Apple's Foundation Models framework — a new Swift package letting Apple developers natively call Claude from Swift for more complex workflows. The design is "layered model use": Apple's on-device models handle fast, local tasks (summarization, extraction), returning typed Swift values via guided generation in as few as three lines; when a request needs multi-step reasoning, code generation, web search, or code execution for data analysis, it hands off seamlessly to cloud Claude. The examples are concrete: a journaling app generates daily prompts on-device, then asks Claude to find threads across months of entries; a study app defines a term on-device, then hands to Claude when the student asks "why does this matter for everything else?" One coherent experience for the user, backed by the right model for each step. It ships on iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / ma…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 发布了对 Apple Foundation Models 框架的 Claude 支持——一个新的 Swift 包，让 Apple 开发者能在 Swift 里原生调用 Claude 处理更复杂的工作流。设计思路是「分层用模型」：Apple 的端侧模型负责快速、本地的任务（如摘要、信息抽取），仅需三行代码就能通过 guided generation 返回带类型的 Swift 值；当请求需要多步推理、代码生成、联网搜索或执行代码做数据分析时，再无缝交给云端的 Claude。举的例子很具体：一个日记 app 可以在端侧生成每日提示词，再让 Claude 跨几个月的条目找出主题线索；一个学习 app 在端侧定义术语，学生追问「这为什么对其它内容都重要」时再交给 Claude。对用户是一个连贯体验，背后是「每一步用对的模型」。该能力将在 iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / macOS 27 / visionOS 27 / watchOS 27 上线，用 Anthropic API key 登录即可。
